I get it... You really wanted an autograph from THE Akai Mato,

My sins are many and terrible... I made a game so good that loads
of people enjoyed it. What an awful thing to do!
Haha! I say that, but it would be really bad if it crashed and
burned and you demanded your money back!
Please no please no please no please no please no.
Did you make this whole game by yourself?
Yep, I made it all by myself. It took me four whole years to finish.
Still, I got a lot of support from ci-en, so it didn't feel like
I was all alone. I had people pushing me to live up to expectations!
I even had original BGM and pixel art made for it, too. Ahh,
I'm so grateful for everything!
I'd really like to keep on making games with help from all my
supporters! Though that dream will never come true if Demons Roots
is a flop, haha!
Did King Exit make a profit?
Wow, we've been talking about money a lot. This game is about
dreams! Let's change the subject. Oh, but I'll tell you one thing.
When I started out, my games didn't sell very quickly and I really
thought I was gonna die, but in the end I was able to create
Demons Roots!
If you just look at the number of sales it might seem like a profit,
but spread out over three years of work... I wonder what the
hourly wage would end up being?
But that's okay! King Exit is well loved. Even now, I still get
people sending me messages saying they enjoyed it!
I'll be honest, the more I peak as a creator the more compliments
I receive. It really... Fills me with emotion.
I hope Demons Roots will also be received the same way, but I won't
know until it goes on sale. What do you think? Did you enjoy it,
even a little bit?
Did Shade really make your BGM?
Did you notice how cool the battle music was?
I asked THE Shade to compose it for me! And he agreed! Incredible!
THE SHADE!
I actually spoke to him on the phone! Amazing, right? I had a
conversation with THE Shade! Kyahhhh!!
Oh, and I got permission for something! Here, the speaker! Take
a listen!
I was only able to get the courage and funds together to commission
this music thanks to my supporters. Thank you, all of you!
Thank you so much!

Rough: Revenge the Demons
Tachie showName Revenge_the_Demons
This is the first rough I received. Crazy, right?
I wanted a song conjures the image of Deathpolca playing the piano,
so Shade composed it in a way that the piano and guitar are
competing with each other, leading to this final product.
Since Shade said he'd leave the name up to me, I came up with
one myself.
The demons, defeated by the humans, are fighting to make a
comeback... Normal battle music.
And 'demon' is also a word that's used to smear someone. Even the
peasants are called 'demons'...
So I wanted a name that included both the demon's revenge,
and the recovery of the peasants. In the end, I went for
'Revenge the Demons'.
Rough: Change the Beats
Tachie showName Change_the_Beats
This one really picks up in the latter half. When I first heard
it, I got goosebumps all over.
In the middle it suddenly bursts open. If you're a fan of Shade,
it'll probably bring some of his other works to mind. I'm so
touched to be able to display it in my own commissioned work.
I wanted to include the word 'change' in the title since this
song is used as battle music in the second half of the game.
Especially since it becomes a regular battle theme after the
demon's overcome the berserk incident and the path splits
from King Exit.
With these beats of change I decided to go with 'Change the Beats'
as the name.
Rough: BLOSSOM
Tachie showName BLOSSAM
As a player, this song may be the one that leaves the biggest
impression. It's the Sage battle BGM from Deathpolca's awakening.
When I commissioned it, all I had of the awakened Deathpolca was
her standing image. It's incredible that Shade was able to put this
rough together based off a single image!
I received the finished song, but after finishing the scene I
decided I wanted more spice to it and asked for another version.
That's the one we have here.
As for the name, 'to blossom' means 'to bloom', 'to flower'.
BLOSSOM, to me, brings a strong image of flowers blooming on a
fruit tree... Like the flowers on a certain someone's head.
It especially makes me think of the scene where the Black Onion
becomes so strong and beautiful. So after putting those two
together, BLOSSOM was the only name that came to mind.
Rough: ENDLESS ENGRAVE
Tachie showName ENDLESS_ENGRAVE
The final battle of Demons Roots... I was planning on putting my
all into it, so it had to have the best possible BGM.
I was really particular with how I wanted it, so it required a
lot of work. Shade put a lot of his soul into it.
I was so moved when I received the rough. He put so much work into
a track for a nameless person like me... Only a real scumbag wouldn't
be moved by that kind of effort.
I'd always intended to do my best with this game, but after I got
Shade's incredible music I really wanted it to be worthy of his
work. Still, it's not easy to make dreams a reality.
That's why I wanted to take advantage of this unique opportunity!
I wanted to use all my ability to make the game, characters, and
scenario a way to lift this song up to the heavens!
*Pant Pant* I got a bit carried away there. Sorry if I seem like I'm
getting a bit ahead of myself. I know that, as a creator, I need to
maintain a sense of humility or I'll be shooting myself in the foot.
This track just lights the fire of passion inside of me.
I hope you'll forgive my temporary slip.
For the name... I struggled with it for a long time. Two years
after receiving the finished track, I still hadn't come up with
a good name for it.
It has such destructive power, so the meaning is kind of ambiguous.
I thought it would work better with a more solemn title. This
song's the one that lets the game shine at its pinnacle.
Essentially, it's the point where the player's emotions are at their
peak. That's why I didn't want to give it a vague title. It had to
have a decisive, impactful name.
After thinking and thinking and thinking it over... I decided to
go with 'a seal that will never end' - ENDLESS ENGRAVE.
It has a lot of meanings. Bless Curse was a being who kept cursing
humanity, even as he tried to bless them.
The sacrifices carved into the beginning of the curse... Even the
protagonists become a part of it. Even in the future King Exit.
It also shows how strong the people who confront the protagonists
are. But not just these game-side elements...
The BGM, the scene, the game... I want all of it to be engraved
into the player's heart forever. Not as a curse, but as something
they achieved after overcoming a real challenge.
I want my games to be the kind where you carry something away
from them and use it to benefit you in your life.
From here on the song names become as easy to understand as I could
make them, but I still get kind of excited whenever I see this
name. I titled ENDLESS ENGRAVE with this feeling in mind!
Rough: regurgitation
Tachie showName regurgitation
I asked for a BGM like the climax of a movie, and what a climax
I got!
For such a profound track, the scene has to equally solemn. The
true final battle of Demons Roots... Did I make it grave enough?
After receiving the rough, I only made one request. Since the boss
of the last battle is 'that girl'...
The first girl you played as in this work comes after you as a
threat. Revised history, prophecies, the ending of King Exit...
I wanted a clock's ticking, full of many-layered meanings.
The title is 'regurgitation', and the meaning is simply that. I
think a simple title suits a track as heavy with meaning as
this one.
Rough: Black line Over
Rough: Ground Dasher
Rough: Black line Over
Tachie showName Black_line_Over
The second I heard this rough, I thought, 'That's Shade's sound!'
and got really excited. I grew up listening to this sound.
The image for the song is 'evil vs evil', 'demons vs villains.'
I don't think there's any composer better suited for this kind of
theme than Shade.
I couldn't say anything about it, from rough to finished product.
It's just too perfect.
For the title, these bad guys are going against common courtesy and
clashing with each other. It's not a place people who lead honest
lives should be stepping into! That's the feeling I wanted.
Cross the line and be dragged into a dangerous fight. That's why
I went with the title 'Black line Over'.
Rough: Ground Dasher
Tachie showName Ground_Dasher
When Shade gave me this rough, he said 'I woke up and it just
hit me.' Any normal person who woke up to this running though
their mind would end up dead.
I'd already completed the in-game scene and made a gameplay video
of Kalinka fighting the King of Plana when I commissioned this one.
Shade told me 'I'm honored to make a track for such a wonderful
scene!' With that lethal compliment, I died. Getting the rough of
the track revived me though.
My only request was that it would be easier for the player if there
was a lead-up to the cool song. I figured it would leave more
of an impression that way.
So the finished version had an opening inserted into it. I created
the PV to emphasize it but... It really is the coolest. I want
this song played at my funeral.
As for the name, it goes without saying.
'GRAND DASHER!!!'(Mitsuya Yuuji's voice)
Except no, it actually has the meaning of 'running over the land.'
The demons and peasants, covered in blood and filth, running towards
their fateful battle.
That's the kind of refined coolness I was aiming for. The title of
a track with the image of a brightly flickering life as it's
extinguished... That's where I got 'Ground Dasher.'
